starterFiles.content: public abstract class Vehicle { private final String plate; protected Vehicle(String plate) { this.plate = plate; } public String getPlate() { return plate; } public abstract int getCapacity(); }
public class Jeepney extends Vehicle { public Jeepney(String plate) { super(plate); } public int getCapacity() { return 20; } }

blocks.instruction: Worked example: show the capacity of one jeepney.

files.content: public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { Vehicle v = new Jeepney("NXA 123"); System.out.println("Capacity: " + v.getCapacity()); } }

activity.instruction: Keep Vehicle as the parent class. Change the Jeepney capacity to 25, then print its capacity from Main.java.

files.content: public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { int i = 3; while (i >= 1) { System.out.println(i); i--; } } }
